verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a server (`llama serve`), so a throughput-serving axis applies. The evidence pack never documents continuous batching across concurrent requests or chunked prefill. The only related item is a community note that prompt ingestion runs in batches; that describes a single prompt being processed in batches, not continuous batching or chunked prefill, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
